music.why: Two of Detroit's greatest in one room at Public Works' anniversary weekend.

music.name: Glaive
music.why: Genre-defying pop artist glaive on his GOD SAVE THE THREE TOUR, in an all-ages room a short walk from Downtown Berkeley BART.
music.summary: glaive brings the GOD SAVE THE THREE TOUR to The UC Theatre in Berkeley, with Kurtains supporting. Doors 7 PM, all ages; the listing shows it as sold out.

music.name: Iron & Wine
music.why: Hushed, literate folk in one of San Francisco's most beautiful old movie palaces.

music.why: Disco-tinged dance-pop from one of the genre's best live acts, in a historic 2,250-cap theater
music.summary: London pop/R&B singer-songwriter Jessie Ware brings her 2026 North American tour to The Warfield, with support from Dhruv.

music.name: The Jungle Giants
music.why: Danceable Brisbane indie-pop in the ornate, intimate Great American Music Hall.

music.name: Neurosis
music.why: Homecoming show for one of the most influential heavy bands ever to come out of Oakland, at a historic room.
music.summary: Bay Area post-metal pioneers Neurosis play the first of two hometown nights at The Fillmore, touring their first new album in a decade, An Undying Love For A Burning World. Both nights were listed as sold out.

music.name: Sara Bareilles
music.why: A sold-out night with the Brave and Love Song singer-pianist in an intimate theater setting.
music.summary: Sara Bareilles brings The Good Grief Tour to the Theater at Bill Graham Civic Auditorium, with Celisse opening. Doors 7 PM, show 8 PM, all ages.

music.name: ScHoolboy Q
music.why: A full-album celebration of the TDE rapper's classic Blank Face LP at one of the Bay's best historic theaters.

music.name: The Seshen, Sweet Lew, Cardboard People
music.why: Bay Area R&B / synth-pop favorites celebrating a decade-old album in an intimate, legendary SF club.

music.name: “Union Square Dances” Free Outdoor Friday Night Dance Party (SF)
music.why: Free, no partner or experience needed, and a lesson is included — an easy downtown Friday-evening dance.

music.why: Tight, playful live funk from a band that rarely tours, in an outdoor amphitheater.

music.why: Jakob Dylan's 90s alt-rock staples ('One Headlight', '6th Avenue Heartache') in an outdoor winery setting above Silicon Valley.

music.name: Burning Man Decompression 2026
music.why: The Bay Area burner community's annual post-playa reunion, with daytime art and night-time dancing until 3am.

music.name: Asha Banks
